title: Process Article
description: Process-level Article for the AI Editorial System (AES-P0.3 / SUE-436). Carries framing, research state, review state, and finalization evidence. Maps deterministically onto the suengj-com canonical publication contract (SBM-03 / SUE-358) without duplicating it.

article_id.description: Stable process identity. The slug segment is the suengj-com global slug once materialized.

content_type.description: What kind of piece this is. Orthogonal to artifacts.

title.description: Display title. Must carry the thesis, not merely name the topic — enforced by the headline-fidelity gate.

dek.description: Optional standfirst. Held to the same fidelity requirement as the title.

lifecycle_authority.description: Who moved the article into its current state. `final` and `published` require human.

source_set.description: Sources that contributed, by source_id, with the content hash observed at use time. Enables source-drift detection.

pinned_ref.description: Commit or immutable ref the claim was verified against. Required for GitHub sources in the project profile: repository prose is a claim, not evidence.

no_article_reason.description: Required when state is no_article. A weak thesis is a legitimate outcome, not a failure to hide.

type_fields.description: Fields required or permitted by the content-type profile (editorial/profiles/content/*.json). Shape varies by type; enforced by scripts/lib/profile-core.mjs rather than by this schema.

presentation_plan_ref.description: Optional. Identifier of a sidecar presentation plan (presentation-plan.schema.json). Additive by design: an article with no plan is complete, and removing a plan never removes information from the canonical Markdown.

state.description: Process lifecycle. Reconciled with, not a replacement for, the suengj-com status contract.

frame.description: Article Frame. Required before any prose is written (Editorial Rule 3).

uncertainty.description: What we do not know. An empty list is not a valid frame.

answer.description: Optional AnswerUnit (AEO-P2.3 / SUE-525). The retrieval-facing compression of what this article answers: a question, one concise answer, and references into claims the article has already verified. Additive by design — an article with no answer unit is complete, and an answer unit never introduces a claim the verification block does not carry.

question.description: The retrieval intent this article answers, in the reader's words rather than the article's headline.

summary.description: One self-contained answer. Capped so it stays an answer rather than becoming a second article.

claims.description: References into verification.claims. Claims are never restated here — only pointed at, with the epistemic kind the publication surface must show and the body text that carries them.

kind.description: What the reader is being offered. `fact` requires a verified claim with evidence; interpretation and forecast are the honest labels for everything else.

anchor.description: Exact text from the canonical body that carries this claim, so a compression can be checked against the full article rather than trusted.

review.description: HITL evidence. Presence of a review block is not approval; `decision` is.

version.description: Version identity used by every derived artifact to decide staleness.

content_hash.description: sha256 over the normalised canonical Markdown (front matter + body). Any edit changes it.

claims_hash.description: sha256 over the ordered verified-claim set (id, text, status). Changes only when the factual substance changes.

publication.description: Mirror of the suengj-com contract. Authoritative values live there; this block records what was handed off.

transformation.description: Required when the article draws on transcript-derived or otherwise non-redistributable sources (AES-P0.4 / SUE-437). Records that the piece is original synthesis rather than a reshaped transcript.

transcript_shaped.description: True means the draft still follows the source's own order and phrasing. Publication is refused while this is true.

original_framing.description: The thesis and structure are ours, not the source's.

synthesis_note.description: What this article does that the sources do not.

attribution.description: How the underlying sources are credited in the body.
